Uebersicht.title: Overview
Uebersicht.body:
Your key figures, each with its value, its date and a way into the screen behind it.

The bank inbox above shows the open bank lines as one number, with three symbols: the person for lines that need you, the check mark for sure proposals, the crossed-out paperclip for lines without a receipt. Each number opens the bank screen. Your bank sits on the right with a dot: green runs, orange waits, red failed, grey means the automatic fetch is off. Point at its name for the words. Under till up, TILL fetches every morning and, during setup, asks daily whether the bank has activated the access.

A tile never shows a false zero.
